<function name="BarScale" parent="DHScrollBar" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Returns the scale of the scroll bar based on the difference in size between the visible "window" into the canvas that is being scrolled. Should be used after <page>DHScrollBar:SetUp</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The scale of the scrollbar.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
